name: elatura
description: An adaptive browser sidecar for oversized interactive applications.

scripts.check: npm run security:gate && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run lint:extension && npm run build:manifest && npm run release:candidate:smoke
scripts.security:gate: node scripts/verify-workspace-locks.mjs && node scripts/security-gate.mjs && node scripts/chromium-extension-gate.mjs && node scripts/transform-safety-gate.mjs && node scripts/release-policy-gate.mjs
scripts.lint:extension: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir extension/firefox/dist
scripts.run:firefox: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir extension/firefox/dist
scripts.release:candidate:unsigned: npm run build && npm run security:gate && web-ext lint --source-dir extension/firefox/dist && npm run build:manifest && node scripts/create-firefox-release-candidate.mjs
